title: Settles Hill Banquets & Events

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Our Ballroom dimensions are 50' 8" x 94' 9". The Ballroom can comfortably hold up to 300 with a dance floor; 350 without a dance floor. Linens are provided in a wide range of color choices.Our Preferred Partners can provide centerpieces and decorations and prices are quoted in advance. You may also provide your own centerpieces and decorations.Wedding events have a minimum of 80 adult guests. Banquets and showers are a minimum of 40 adult guests. Private parties and corporate events also require a minimum of 40 adults guests. Funeral Services require a minimum of 40 adult guests with minimal notice, when the room is available. blurb: Are you searching for a beautiful event venue to host your wedding? Do you need a large space for your next family reunion or corporate event? Settles Hill Banquets & Events in Altamont, NY is the perfect spot. We'll take the worry off your shoulders and give you a memorable time at our venue. We offer services for wedding events, shower events, private parties, school sports banquets & more.
